input: Read /doc/README.md and generate a table of contents from its headings (lines starting with # or ##). Insert the TOC after the first heading, formatted as a markdown list with '- [Heading Text](#anchor)' where anchor is the heading text lowercased with spaces replaced by hyphens. Write the result back to the file.

transcript.final_response:
TOC inserted into `/doc/README.md` after the first heading:

```markdown
# Project Alpha

- [Project Alpha](#project-alpha)
- [Installation](#installation)
- [Usage](#usage)
- [API Reference](#api-reference)
- [Contributing](#contributing)

Introduction to the project.

## Installation

Run the installer.

## Usage

How to use it.

## API Reference

Endpoint documentation.

## Contributing

PR guidelines.
```

All headings (`#`/`##` lines) were converted to `- [Text](#anchor)` with anchors lowercased and spaces replaced by hyphens, and the result was written back to the file.
tool_calls:
file="/doc/README.md"
# Find first heading line number
first=$(grep -n -m1 '^#' "$file" | cut -d: -f1)
echo "first heading line: $first"
# Generate TOC
grep '^#' "$file" | while IFS= read -r line; do
  text=$(echo "$line" | sed -E 's/^#+ *//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
  anchor=$(echo "$text" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '-')
  echo "- [$text](#$anchor)"
done | tee /tmp/toc.txt
echo "---TOC GENERATED---"
cat /tmp/toc.txt

file="/doc/README.md"
toc="/tmp/toc.txt"
# Regenerate TOC to be safe (overwrite)
grep '^#' "$file" | while IFS= read -r line; do
  text=$(echo "$line" | sed -E 's/^#+ *//; s/[[:space:]]*$//')
  anchor=$(echo "$text" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | tr ' ' '-')
  echo "- [$text](#$anchor)"
done > "$toc"
cat "$toc"
echo "---"
first=$(grep -n -m1 '^#' "$file" | cut -d: -f1)
echo "first=$first"

# Build new file: heading + blank + TOC + blank + rest (without duplicate blank)
head -n "$first" "$file" > /tmp/new.md
echo "" >> /tmp/new.md
cat "$toc" >> /tmp/new.md
echo "" >> /tmp/new.md
# tail from first+1, strip a single leading blank line if present to avoid double blank
tail -n +"$((first+1))" "$file" | sed -e '1{/^$/d}' >> /tmp/new.md

echo "=== NEW FILE ==="
cat /tmp/new.md
echo "=== CAT -A ==="
cat -A /tmp/new.md

cat /tmp/new.md > "$file"
echo "=== WRITTEN ==="
cat /doc/README.md
